Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3100); Joel, an Israelite:--Joel.
BiblicalUsage: Joel is the prophet Peter quotes on the day of Pentecost. In Acts 2:16 Peter stands up and says, this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel, and pours out the promise that God will pour out his Spirit upon all flesh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Joel's name is tied to Pentecost forever: the prophet who saw the Spirit poured out, and the apostle who saw it happen.
